newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore ST index ends lower on selected selling.
newsitem.headline: Singapore ST index ends lower on selected selling.

text.p: Singapore's key stock index eased on Wednesday due to selected sales in some blue chips, but most stocks ticked broadly higher on active volume.
"Today was generally a good volume day. Pressure was mostly on Cycle & Carriage," a dealer with a foreign brokerage said.
The Singapore Straits Times Industrial Index closed down 3.33 points at 2,243.26. Activity was buoyant with 219.6 million shares traded producing 343 gainers and 80 losers.
Dealers said Cycle & Carriage shares dropped for a second day because of reports that it was losing market share to Japanese car manufacturers.
But the market overall remained optimistic on the domestic economy and cheered by Wall Street's overnight record close.
A forecast for an upturn in electronics in the second half of the year enabled other sectors to ride on its coattails.
Creative Technology the led gainers, up Singapore $0.90 at $15.80, while technology-related SM Summit Holdings was most traded with 15.48 million units changing hands to end $0.06 higher at $0.60.
Losers were led by Cycle & Carriage, down $0.70 to $16.80, and Fraser & Neave, down $0.30 to $14.00.
